newsitem.title: USA: Metal Management plans Arizona acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Metal Management plans Arizona acquisition.

text.p: Metal Management Inc said Monday it agreed to purchase Newell Phoenix L.L.C.'s 50 percent stake in Salt River Recycling L.L.C., which operates as a shredder and processor of ferrous scrap metal and has estimated annualized gross revenues of $12 million.
Metal Management will acquire the other half-interest in Salt River Recycling when it closes its pending merger with Cozzi Iron & Metal Inc, the largest scrap metal recycling operation in Chicago.
In the transaction, Arizona-based Newell Phoenix L.L.C. will receive either 100,000 shares of Metal Management's common stock or $1.5 million in cash, at Newell Phoenix L.L.C.'s election.

The closing of the transaction requires, among other things, completion of a definitive merger agreement and consummation of the transaction between Cozzi Iron & Metal, Inc. and Metal Management. It also requires successful completion of due diligence and obtaining of necessary financing.
Metal Management is expanding its business through acquisition in the consoliding scrap metal recycling industry.
Shares of Metal Management were trading up 1-1/8 to 20-3/8.
